column1: # Term-recall equivalences (labeling plan Part A, cleaning plan v7 "Scoring changes" 1; terms.Matcher,
# score_domain.term_occurrences). One group per line, "form<TAB>form[<TAB>...]", written as the evaluation normalizer
# writes them ("mg kg" is how "mg/kg" normalizes). A reference occurrence of a listed term that directly follows a
# number token (after normalization: "five hundred milligrams" is "500 milligrams") is reproduced by any form of its
# group at the aligned position, in either direction ("500 mg" reproduces "500 milligrams", and the reverse). Only
# listed terms are occurrences; forms that are not listed terms today ("ml", "mmhg") are left out. Approved by AJ:
# mg; confirmed 2026-10-30: mcg, meq, mmol and the "per" forms.
